_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); chemical and refining signals

pit_profile.why: Risk factor (FY2017 10-K): Our business operations are subject to the cyclical and volatile nature of the supply-demand balance in the chemical and refining industries.; of the other live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles': none names chemicals or refining, and no 10-K names cloud, offshore delivery, e-commerce, or streaming; ENERGY_TRANSITION is live (from 2015-12-12): the Refining segment refines crude oil and the greenhouse gas risk factor puts the theme on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for LyondellBasell

theme_watch.reason: Live: LyondellBasell's own FY2017 10-K says 'Refining. Our Refining segment refines heavy, high-sulfur crude oil and other crude oils of varied types and sources available on the U.S. Gulf Coast into refined products including gasoline and distillates.' and, of greenhouse gas laws and regulations, 'Compliance with these or other changes in laws, regulations and obligations that create a GHG emissions trading scheme or GHG reduction policies generally could significantly increase our costs or reduce demand for products we produce.' The stock trades at 9.3x FY18E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ENERGY_TRANSITION) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing decarbonisation of LyondellBasell's refining and the demand for its products specifically.

classification.quality_note: Risk factor (FY2017 10-K): Our business operations are subject to the cyclical and volatile nature of the supply-demand balance in the chemical and refining industries.; of the other live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles': none names chemicals or refining, and no 10-K names cloud, offshore delivery, e-commerce, or streaming; ENERGY_TRANSITION is live (from 2015-12-12): the Refining segment refines crude oil and the greenhouse gas risk factor puts the theme on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for LyondellBasell. cyclical (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.46x; +32% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.22; conservative 2yr +45%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -4.7%/yr (worst year FY11-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +21.0%/yr (Q1 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 7.4-yr ex-FY10 median

BULL.desc: EPS +21.0%/yr (FY11-FY17 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +27.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY17, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LYB (retrospective, 2018-05-25) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.46x (27.0% downside to Bear $83 / +59.1% upside to Bull $181) | Adj composite 2.15 vs market 1.93: gap +0.22 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +32% above the EPP floor $86 (7x FY18E $12.28) | Conservative 2-yr case: +44.7% total (+22.4%/yr) | At 9.3x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $150 sits at or below the BASE case; O&P–Americas +16.5% and Intermediates & Derivatives +51.7% operating income in Q1 2018, forward revenues +15.9% (no FY18 revenue guide in numbers, Q1 2018 revenues as reported); the energy transition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
